title: BusinessGoalArtifact
description: S1 output: the seed content of the requirements pipeline. In PACT terms this is the ThingRef of the business_goal Token, seeded only by product_owner (SeedAuthority).

problem_statement.description: One-sentence problem statement following the S1 template (affected group, situation, current state, quantified pain, desired state, measurable target, supporting business objective).

problem_frame_analysis.description: Optional problem-frame analysis per methods/problem-statement.md (machine, problem world, requirement, world properties, frame classification).

stakeholder_map.description: Must cover at least three role classes (users, decision makers, affected parties).

hidden_knowledge.description: Tacit knowledge unique to this role.

out_of_scope.description: Must be non-empty: a scope that includes everything is no scope at all (gate-1).

success_criteria.description: Stated in business language, never technical language.

open_questions.description: Questions left for the elicitation stage (S2).
